In the context of the name, "Zheena," the word "zeen" is used to describe a woman with the beauty, grace, and elegance of jasmine flowers. This name stands out for its unique spelling and exotic connotation, fitting well in the multicultural and diverse nature of our world today.

They are often mentioned in hadiths and poetry as a reminder of the divine beauty and perfection of Allah's creation. By giving the name "Zheena," parents bestow upon their child a name that not only signifies physical beauty but also reminds her of the inner beauty and spiritual excellence that is sought in Islam. It encourages her to strive for excellence and beauty in all aspects of her life, both in her outer appearance and in her character.
